children: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. (NASDAQ:BMRN) sealed a patent settlement with Ascendis that grants BioMarin a non‑exclusive global license and royalty stream while Ascendis commercializes TransCon CNP/navepegritide, completed the Aug. 31, 2026 acquisition of Alesta Therapeutics (now a subsidiary) for ALE1, and saw Jefferies nudge its price target to $105.00.

: BioMarin (BMRN) and Ascendis settled patents for TransCon CNP/navepegritide: BioMarin granted a non‑exclusive global license and covenants; Ascendis will commercialize and pay royalties to BioMarin.
: BioMarin (BMRN) closed acquisition of Alesta Therapeutics on Aug 31, 2026, acquiring ALE1, an oral Phase 1/2a HPP candidate; Alesta is now a BioMarin subsidiary.
: Jefferies raised its price target for BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. (BMRN) to $105.00 per share from $104.00; no other actions or commentary from Jefferies were reported in the provided summary.
